headline: 14 Crew Rescued as Cargo Ship Sinks
subheadline: Heavy-weather flooding sank a steel-laden ship
insight: Two starboard compartments flooded in gales and 4 m waves off Binhai, Jiangsu. The steel-laden ship listed and sank; the Donghai Rescue Bureau saved all 14 crew.

sources.title: 14 rescued after cargo ship sinks off east China coast
14 Seafarers Rescued After Chinese Bulk Carrier Sinks In Yellow Sea

factCheck.notes: Location, cargo, flooding, weather, rescue assets and crew count from Bastille Post report citing the Donghai Rescue Bureau; sinking date 9 Nov and 14 crew rescued corroborated by Marine Insight. Vessel name not used (not confirmed in sources read). Cause beyond reported flooding not established.

meta.description: A Chinese cargo ship loaded with steel sank about 20 nautical miles northeast of Binhai Port, Yancheng, Jiangsu Province, on the morning of 9 November 2026 after high winds and heavy waves flooded two starboard compartments and the ship took a severe list. Eight crew went into the water during a severe cold wave. The Donghai Rescue Bureau of China's Ministry of Transport sent a rescue vessel and two helicopters, working in gale-force winds and 4-metre waves, and all 14 crew were rescued.
